guides.definition: Defines the application class and starts the Spring container. Project dependency only: use a configured Spring Boot Maven or Gradle project; the isolated Java runner does not resolve external dependencies.

parameters.name: className
parameters.description: Public application class name matching its source file.

examples.title: Start an Atlas service
examples.explanation: @SpringBootApplication enables configuration, component scanning, and auto-configuration from one conventional root class.

guides.definition: Defines a Spring MVC controller with one GET endpoint. Project dependency only: use a configured Spring Boot Maven or Gradle project; the isolated Java runner does not resolve external dependencies.

parameters.name: basePath
parameters.description: Path shared by every controller method.

parameters.name: route
parameters.description: GET route relative to the base path.

parameters.name: returnType
parameters.description: Method return type serialized into the response.

examples.title: Expose a health endpoint
examples.explanation: @RestController serializes return values into the response; keep transport validation and domain behavior separated as endpoints grow.

guides.definition: Binds a configuration prefix to an immutable Java record. Project dependency only: use a configured Spring Boot Maven or Gradle project; the isolated Java runner does not resolve external dependencies.

examples.title: Bind client settings
examples.explanation: Typed configuration makes expected keys and value types explicit; register the record through configuration-properties scanning or enablement.
